production_safety.operational_data: No operational records were read or changed. Existing bundled brand assets were reused.
production_safety.schema_migration: none: no backend, schema or storage-key changes.
external_side_effects: Google Fonts requests for display typography during preview.
No publishing, real ordering, payment or messaging occurred.

verification.evidence: Final Next.js production build and TypeScript checks passed; all existing routes and eight product details generated.
10/10 desktop/mobile Chromium cases passed after final edits in 29.1 seconds against local preview; selection, cart, demo checkout, image loading, locator and 404 recovery verified.

verification.command: Visual inspection of artifacts/preview-desktop.png, preview-mobile.png and home-desktop.png
verification.evidence: Confirmed new antique cabinet and complete page composition; mobile reordered to lead with the pie photograph; no horizontal page overflow.

residual_risks: The existing checkout remains a demonstration; no live payment, inventory or administrator integration was added.
External Google fonts require network access and fall back to system serif fonts.
Tests use Chromium desktop and mobile emulation; other browser engines and physical devices were not tested.
Existing reference prices, food information and image publication rights still require operator confirmation.
